local_regression_checks.active_session_semantics: Regression verifies a future constructed before its active session is polled within that session and keeps its event ownership across a yield.
local_regression_checks.stack_limit_policy: No global runtime stack increase. The fixture adds a 1 MiB child stack limit only on Linux and uses native child stacks elsewhere.
local_regression_checks.evidence_limit: The Linux 1 MiB initialized child control also passed before the scope fix. It does not reproduce the Windows crash; the pre-fix future-size regression and native Windows CI are the direct before/after evidence.

limitations: This history covers only its stated source heads. Later human-harness and release changes require their own matrix checks.
A failed Cargo command stops before later test targets; partial target totals are not complete-suite results.
Ignored and skipped tests remain separate from passes; platform-specific compiled tests account for different Rust totals.
Earlier log byte counts and hashes unavailable in these inputs remain null. They were not reconstructed or guessed.
Raw decoded CI logs are retained locally outside this receipt and must not be bundled for publication.
No real provider, hosted study, or human cohort was run by this verification work.
